link.note: If a Banach space X has UPFP and either X is isomorphic to ell_p(X) for some 1<=p<=infinity or to c0(X), or X* has finite cotype, then ell_1(X) has UPFP and is primary. Completeness is an explicit binder. The two alternatives are a disjunction, and cotype concerns the actual bounded linear dual. The self-similarity quantifier includes p=1 and p=infinity and the separate c0 alternative. Both conclusions are retained.
